articles.summary: Company Reaffirms Full-Year 2026 Guidance Announces $150 Million Increase in Share Repurchase Authorization MIAMI, Oct. 29, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) - Laureate Education, Inc. (NASDAQ: LAUR), which operates five higher education institutions across Mexico and Peru, today announced financial results for the third quarter and nine months ended September 30, 2026. Third Quarter 2026 Highlights (compared to third quarter 2025 ): On a reported basis, revenue increased 21% to $485.1 million. On a constant currency basis 1 , revenue increased 14% and was favorably affected by approximately $29 million of intra-year academic calendar timing attributable to semester start dates in 2026 as compared to 2025. Operating income for the third quarter of 2026 was $119.1 million, compared to operating income of $71.5 million for the third quarter of 2025.
